flashcard_questions.q: What is a finite natural resource?
flashcard_questions.a: One being used up faster than it can be replaced, such as fossil fuels or metal ores.

flashcard_questions.q: What does sustainable development mean in practice?
flashcard_questions.a: Meeting the needs of today without stopping future generations meeting their own.

flashcard_questions.q: What is meant by potable water?
flashcard_questions.a: Water that is safe to drink, although it still contains some dissolved substances.

flashcard_questions.q: Treating surface water: ____ through sand and gravel → sedimentation → ____ with chlorine
Which chemical is commonly added to kill microbes in UK drinking water?
How does phytomining extract metal from low-grade soil?
flashcard_questions.a: Plants absorb the metal ions, then are harvested and burned, and metal is taken from the ash.
Removing the salt and other dissolved minerals to produce fresh water.

flashcard_questions.q: Why is desalination an expensive way to make potable water?
flashcard_questions.a: Both distillation and reverse osmosis need large amounts of energy.

flashcard_questions.q: What is removed at the screening stage of waste water treatment?
flashcard_questions.a: Large objects such as rags and plastic, caught on metal grilles.

flashcard_questions.q: Which useful fuel is produced by anaerobic digestion of sewage sludge?
Why is the liquid effluent treated with aerobic bacteria?
flashcard_questions.a: To break down the organic matter still in it before the water is released.

flashcard_questions.q: What does a life cycle assessment examine?
flashcard_questions.a: The environmental impact of a product at every stage, from cradle to grave.

flashcard_questions.q: Why can a life cycle assessment be subjective?
flashcard_questions.a: Some impacts are hard to measure, so they involve value judgements.

flashcard_questions.q: How much of the extraction energy does recycling aluminium use?
How does bioleaching extract metal from a low-grade ore?
flashcard_questions.a: Bacteria produce an acidic leachate that holds the metal compounds in solution.
